class.name: RayCastResult
class.brief_description: The result of a raycast operation.
class.description: The result of a raycast operation, typically one dispatched by [RayCast3DDirect]. This is significantly faster than the typical [Dictionary] returned by [method PhysicsDirectSpaceState3D::interset_ray].

method.name: get_success
method.description: [code]true[/code] if the ray hit something, [code]false[/code] otherwise.

method.name: get_hit_position
method.description: The position that the ray intersected with something, or zero if nothing was hit.

method.name: get_hit_normal
method.description: The direction of the surface that the ray intersected with, or zero if nothing was hit.

method.name: get_rid
method.description: The [RID] of the collider that was hit, or 0 if nothing was hit.

method.name: get_hit_object_id
method.description: The object identifier of the thing that was hit. [b]Note that this may correspond to a Godot object, or it may respond to a Conservatory object.[/b] You can use [code]ConservatoryObject.GetObject[/code] to query for this ID, or use one of the extension methods provided in C#.

method.name: get_hit_godot_object
method.description: Returns the first [b]Godot[/b] object that the ray intersects, or [code]null[/code] if no object is intersecting the ray, [b]or if the object is from The Conservatory (and does not extend a Godot object type).[/b] The Conservatory injects into the Godot namespace to provide extension methods that make it more convenient to get game objects that are not translatable to Godot types.

method.name: get_collider_type
method.description: Returns the type of physics object that was hit.

method.name: get_shape_index
method.description: Returns the numeric index of the shape within the collider that was hit, or [code]-1[/code] if nothing was hit.

method.name: get_face_index
method.description: Returns the collision object's face index at the collision point, or [code]-1[/code] if the shape intersecting the ray is not a [ConcavePolygonShape3D]. [b]Note:[/b] If the current physics engine is set to Jolt Physics, you must enable [code]physics/jolt_physics_3d/queries/enable_ray_cast_face_index[/code], which has a nontrivial memory cost (and is thus not recommended). If this setting is not enabled, an error will be raised when reading this property, unless it has been overridden on initialization.
